name: Suryavanshi Spinning Mills Limited
about: Suryavanshi Spinning Mills Limited manufactures and sells polyester yarns in India. The company provides grey cotton combed and carded, cotton/polyester blended, and polyester/viscose blended spun yarn; specialty yarn, which includes melange, grindle, doubled, and slub/fancy yarn; and cotton dyed yarn, and cotton /polyester blended dyed yarns. It also offers men's, ladies, and kids wear garments. In addition, the company provides medical textiles products and other textiles. The company serves defense sector. It exports to the United States, Europe, Japan, China, Korea, Vietnam, Hong Kong, Bangladesh, Italy, Egypt, and internationally. Suryavanshi Spinning Mills Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
